KICK family as CONFIG. Each seed is the C voice's former per-variant literals for its
variant, extracted from modular_stages.c rather than hand-transcribed — that
includes attack/fade/sat, which the legacy binding passed as NaN and which a
seed MUST state explicitly (gen_kick_sat left at the schema identity 0
silences the voice outright).

drum-kick -> C gen_kick_base

fixed peak, more punch and body, same variant, pitch and >250 Hz timbre. Changed:
pe_amt 0.1→0.25, click 0.35→0.15, attack 0.3→0, h2 0.4→0.16, sat
0.55→0.85, noise 0.18→0.13, pe_rate 30→26
